clips.title: The story
paras: Giant Crocolisk Skins are thick hides taken from the massive reptiles native to the marshes of the Wetlands. Prized by Menethil Harbor tradesmen for leatherworking, harvesting them is perilous work that has maimed more than one unwary hunter.

The bogs and waterways of the Wetlands are home to enormous crocolisks whose hides are dense enough to resist the damp rot of the marshes. In Menethil Harbor, artisans like James Halloran rely on steady shipments of skins to craft rugged leather goods. However, taking a hide from a fully grown giant crocolisk requires braving deep waters and outmatching ferocious swamp predators, making every gathered pelt hard-won.
